newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Stena says UK decision unnecessary.
newsitem.headline: Stena says UK decision unnecessary.

text.p: Swedish shipping company Stena Line AB criticised a decision by the British government to refer its planned joint venture with P & O on English channel routes to its main competition watchdog, saying this was unnecessary.
Stena said in a statement it would remain a full competitor with P&O on the routes for at least three months.

Stena said the channel tunnel had already taken a market share of at least 45 percent on cross channel traffic. "It's hard to understand just why the competitive aspect needs further investigation," said Stena.

Stena Line Managing Director said the delayed start to its joint scheduling venture with P&O would mean that the financial benefits of the deal would be delayed. -- Simon Haydon, Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700-1004
